# Draft:Pier (software)

Pier is an open-source content management system written in Smalltalk. It relies on [[Seaside (software)] as a webserver and Pillar for markup. The official site is [https://www.piercms.com/]. The latest code is accessible at [https://github.com/Pier-CMS/Pier3]. The project started as SmallWiki, then SmallWiki 2, and was renamed to Pier.
Like a wiki, Pier allows content editing directly in a web browser.
Features:
- The content can be displayed as a webpage, reformatted in a book, or displayed in the Smalltalk system in the Omni browser
- Customization: Pier is designed to be extended and customized.
History - Started as Smallwiki, need to find the year.
